title: Sun exalted in Aries
text: An exalted Sun gives powerful vitality, natural leadership, strong will and a noble, dignified character. Authority comes readily and the native commands respect. This is among the best possible placements for confidence and public standing.

title: Sun debilitated in Libra
text: A debilitated Sun can undermine confidence and self-worth, making the native dependent on others' approval or uneasy with authority. With supporting factors (a cancellation of debility, or benefic aspect) this softens, and humility can become a genuine strength.

title: Moon exalted in Taurus
text: An exalted Moon gives emotional stability, a calm and contented mind, popularity and material comfort. The native is nurturing, well-liked and emotionally secure, with a steady and generous disposition.

title: Moon debilitated in Scorpio
text: A debilitated Moon can bring emotional intensity, restlessness or a tendency to brood, with strong and sometimes turbulent feelings. Channelled well, it grants depth, resilience and transformative emotional insight.

title: Mars exalted in Capricorn
text: An exalted Mars gives disciplined courage, executive ability and the stamina to pursue long, demanding goals. Energy is well-directed rather than impulsive, making the native an effective leader, builder or strategist.

title: Mars debilitated in Cancer
text: A debilitated Mars can make energy and anger harder to direct — sometimes suppressed, sometimes reactive — and confidence may waver under pressure. Emotional security and a clear cause help the native focus this energy constructively.

title: Mercury exalted in Virgo
text: An exalted Mercury (also its own sign) gives sharp intellect, precise analysis, excellent communication and strong business sense. The native excels in study, writing, commerce and any field rewarding clarity and detail.

title: Jupiter exalted in Cancer
text: An exalted Jupiter gives wisdom, generosity, strong ethics, faith and abundant good fortune. The native is respected as a guide or benefactor, enjoys protection in adversity, and prospers through knowledge, teaching and benevolence.

title: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn
text: A debilitated Jupiter can make faith, optimism or generosity harder to access, and the native may be overly pragmatic or skeptical of guidance. Cultivating genuine principles and mentors restores Jupiter's blessings over time.

title: Venus exalted in Pisces
text: An exalted Venus gives refined artistic taste, deep capacity for love, grace and devotion, and good fortune in relationships and comforts. The native is compassionate, creative and often blessed with beauty and material ease.

title: Venus debilitated in Virgo
text: A debilitated Venus can make affection more analytical or reserved, and the native may set exacting standards in love or undervalue their own charm. Self-acceptance and warmth free Venus to express its natural grace.

title: Saturn exalted in Libra
text: An exalted Saturn gives justice, integrity, organisational mastery and the ability to build lasting structures. The native is fair, disciplined and respected for responsibility, often rising to positions of authority through sustained effort.

title: Saturn debilitated in Aries
text: A debilitated Saturn can bring impatience with discipline, fear of limitation, or a struggle between haste and caution. Learning steady, methodical effort turns this placement's early frustrations into hard-won competence.
